f.title: Apply ICH E2A, E2F and E3 (step 4, and their updates) as adopted by ANMAT
f.statement: ANMAT adopts the following ICH guidelines and their updates: ICH E2A step 4 (Clinical Safety Data Management: definitions and standards for expedited reporting), ICH E2F step 4 (Development Safety Update Report) and ICH E3 step 4 (Structure and Content of Clinical Study Reports). The guidelines are made available on the ANMAT institutional website.
f.topic: Adoption of ICH E2A, E2F and E3
f.applicability: Safety reports and clinical study reports for clinical pharmacology studies authorised in Argentina; in force from publication in the Boletín Oficial (24 Jun 2025). Original language Spanish.
f.systems: ICH E2A; ICH E2F; ICH E3
f.processes: Regulatory intelligence; Submission operations; Aggregate reporting

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of authorised clinical pharmacology studies
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 1º Adóptanse las siguientes Guías del Consejo Internacional para la Armonización de Requisitos Técnicos de Productos Farmacéuticos de Uso Humano (Guías ICH) y sus actualizaciones: a. ICH E2A versión paso 4 Gestión de datos de seguridad clínica: definiciones y estándares para informes expeditos (ICH E2A step 4 version Clinical Safety Data Management: definitions and standards for expedited reporting) / b. ICH E2F versión paso 4 Informe de actualización de seguridad del desarrollo (ICH E2F step 4 version Development Safety Update Report) c. ICH E3 versión paso 4 Estructura y contenido del Reporte de Estudio Clínico (ICH E3 step 4 version Structure and Content of Clinical Study Report). Las mencionadas guías se encontrarán disponibles en el sitio institucional de la ANMAT.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'Adóptanse' is an operative adopting provision, Mandatory kept; no further sponsor duty in Arts 3-4 (entry into force, communication). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Below 90: "Adóptanse" is an adopting provision with no modal verb; the sponsor actor is inferred.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 1 The following Guidelines of the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH Guidelines) and their updates are adopted: a. ICH E2A step 4 version Clinical Safety Data Management: definitions and standards for expedited reporting; b. ICH E2F step 4 version Development Safety Update Report; c. ICH E3 step 4 version Structure and Content of Clinical Study Report. The said guidelines will be available on the ANMAT institutional website.

f.title: Keep meeting existing safety-report and study-report obligations through the current submission channels
f.statement: The adoption of ICH E2A, E2F and E3 does not change the safety-report and study-report obligations and responsibilities set out in Disposición ANMAT 6677/10; they remain in force and will continue to be fulfilled through the current channels for submitting these procedures described in the instructions published on the ANMAT institutional website.
f.applicability: Safety reports (SUSARs, safety reports) and study reports for clinical pharmacology studies authorised in Argentina. Note: Disposición 6677/10 was repealed by Disposición 7516/2025 with effect from 1 Dec 2025. Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) of authorised clinical pharmacology studies
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 2°- Lo dispuesto en el artículo 1° no modifica las obligaciones y responsabilidades previstas en materia de informes de seguridad y reportes de estudios en la Disposición ANMAT N° 6677/10, las que continúan vigentes y se seguirán cumplimentando por las vías actuales para la presentación de estos trámites contempladas en el instructivo publicado en la página web institucional.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; applicability already notes that 6677/10 was repealed by Disp. 7516/2025 from 1 Dec 2025, so this continuity provision is of transitional relevance only. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Below 90: continuity clause with no modal verb ("no modifica", "continúan vigentes", "se seguirán cumplimentando"), actor inferred, and the 6677/10 obligations it preserves were repealed by Disp. 7516/2025 from 1 Dec 2025.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 2 The provisions of Article 1 do not modify the obligations and responsibilities set out regarding safety reports and study reports in ANMAT Disposition No. 6677/10, which remain in force and will continue to be fulfilled through the current channels for submitting these procedures provided for in the instructions published on the institutional website.
